name: write-keyed-results
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import json,subprocess,re,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
rows=[json.loads(x) for x in Path('original20.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
notes={
346863:('KNOWN_PUBLIC','regularity-proof','Exact quotient bound is preprint Corollary 2.7; see full η≤c bridge in DERIVATIONS.','No new endpoint; public proof already covers arbitrary simple graphs and fields.'),
346885:('PARK_SOURCE_STATUS_CONFLICT','cocircuit','Proposition 1.6 reaches equality in the target bound and defeats a stronger bound only.','Need a proof of diam≤n−r+2 in all ranks or actual distance strictly exceeding it.'),
346926:('PARK_NO_QUALIFIED_MECHANISM',None,'Literal read only; same coordinate ring is insufficient for quasi-cluster equivalence.','Need exact source/target seeds and a full mutation-plus-frozen-monomial transformation for every reduced plabic graph.'),
346957:('PARK_UNPAID_FINITE_GENERATION','polyhedral','Conjecture 1, all fixed k, not merely k=2.','Need finite rational description of the full infinite intersection for each k, or a proved nonpolyhedral example.'),
346959:('PARK_SOURCE_HYPOTHESES','polyhedral','Conjecture 3 uses lattice subspaces and projected integer lattice, not arbitrary irrational subspaces.','Need uniform finite-generation theorem over all k-dimensional lattice subspaces; H_k=P_k is not available for k≥3.'),
346985:('PARK_SUSTAINED_UNPAID','dice','Parity clause proved, decomposition unpaid after prefix extraction and simultaneous projection lifting routes.','Exact extraction or lifting lemma in DERIVATIONS; no proved separating move invariant for a counterexample.'),
347253:('PARK_NO_QUALIFIED_MECHANISM',None,'Literal read only; equality of all bi-/mono-bracket Q-spans is unbounded in weight and depth.','Need explicit finite Q-linear reduction of every bi-bracket, or independence certificate of a specific bi-bracket against the entire mono-bracket span.'),
347266:('HOLD_CONCRETE_UNREAD_PRIMARY_CLAIMS',None,'Search 2 supplies type-A classification and a finite-type reduced-word criterion/counterexample lead; snippets are not proof.','Need primary comparison of original reduced-word I-sphericity with later standard-Coxeter criterion, particularly D4/F4; cannot substitute all-type statement silently.'),
347339:('PARK_NO_QUALIFIED_MECHANISM',None,'Literal read only; OM or CUOM subclasses do not cover every COM.','Need ample completion preserving exact VC dimension for arbitrary COM, with source COM axioms and embedding verified.'),
347363:('KNOWN_PUBLIC','nonbacktracking','Own complete C6 □ K4 Jordan-chain refutation plus exact 2025 primary public refutation.','No mathematical gap in the ordinary witness; novelty fails because the identified question was already publicly refuted.'),
347403:('PARK_NO_QUALIFIED_MECHANISM',None,'Literal read only; finite graph Ramsey paths do not automatically yield a countable disjoint cover.','Need finite exceptional set and ≤r vertex-disjoint monochromatic paths covering all other vertices under arbitrary countable bipartite coloring, with precise path conventions.'),
347465:('PARK_NO_QUALIFIED_MECHANISM',None,'Literal read only; matching total degree does not by itself construct a cellular nonorientable embedding.','Need exact source Euler characteristic and realization conventions, and pairing/rotation or signed embedding construction with prescribed two degree lists for every feasible χ≤0.'),
347506:('EXCLUDE_ROUTINE_SOURCE_INTERNAL_CORRECTION','circular','Source Corollary 4.9 refutes literal Conjecture 4.10 for n=3,k=1, any δ>0.','Complete contrary comparison in DERIVATIONS; k>2 repaired conjecture remains untouched.'),
347534:('PARK_ADMISSIBLE_DOMAIN','ulam','Finite-group shortcut violates source size-function premise; free rank-two ray does not descend to torsion quotients.','Need arbitrary admissible rank-one relation quotient/torsion-order infinitude, beyond n<5 or special lattice results.'),
347549:('KNOWN_PUBLIC','foatic','Exact action τ=Q²F^{-1}RF and all-n coboundary proof, public Mao Theorem 3.1(3).','No unpaid ordinary bridge for homomesy; public October/November 2026 primary theorem predates this lane.'),
347581:('PARK_NO_QUALIFIED_MECHANISM',None,'Literal read only; scale>1 does not alone contradict virtual regularity.','Need source definition of virtual regularity and an infinite stabilizer obstruction for the associated boundary action of every stated topologically simple group.'),
347660:('PARK_UNPAID_QUANTITATIVE_PROGRESS','origami','Conjecture 1.8; proximity to geodesic and strictly decreasing slope do not bound parametrized length.','Need uniform quasi-geodesic inequalities for every subpath with literal coherent origami hypotheses.'),
347661:('PARK_UNPAID_GREEDY_OPTIMALITY','origami','Conjecture 1.9; replacing a step with less endpoint intersection can destroy valid coherent continuation.','Need complete replacement lemma preserving shortest-path admissibility or explicit shortest coherent path violating local intersection minimum.'),
347663:('PARK_NO_QUALIFIED_MECHANISM',None,'Literal read only; s=3 is the core diameter-free real-set estimate.','Need J_{3,2}(A)≤Cε|A|^{3+ε} for all finite nonempty real A with uniform constants, then exact convolution bridge for all s; no analytic mechanism found.'),
347741:('PARK_NO_QUALIFIED_MECHANISM',None,'Literal read only; bounded-degree quasiconformal comparison misses the conjectural unbounded-degree domain.','Need EQ/VEL equivalence for arbitrary plane triangulations, or a fully proved type-separating triangulation with exact definitions.')}
pro=json.loads(Path('provenance.json').read_text());pmap={x['id']:x for x in pro}
for raw in Path('original20.jsonl').read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True):
 o=json.loads(raw);m=re.search(rb'"statement"\s*:\s*("(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*")',raw);assert m
 pmap[o['mathdb_id']]['raw_statement_json_token_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(m.group(1)).hexdigest()
results={}
for o in rows:
 i=o['mathdb_id'];state,src,assessment,gap=notes[i]
 results[str(i)]={'mathdb_id':i,'literal_statement':o['statement'],'original_record_file':'original20.jsonl','provenance':pmap[i],'reserved_primary_source_url':o['source_url'],'disposition':state,'credit':0,'assessment':assessment,'exact_unpaid_lemma_or_terminal_reason':gap,'ordinary_derivations':'DERIVATIONS.md','gates':{'literal':'READ_AND_PRESERVED','source':'TARGET_RELEVANT_PRIMARY_PASSAGES_READ' if src else 'UNQUALIFIED_PRIMARY_BODY_UNREAD','mathematics':'COMPLETE_ORDINARY_ENDPOINT_UNCREDITED' if i in [346863,347363,347506,347549] else 'UNRESOLVED','prior':'APPLICABLE_PUBLIC_PRIMARY_BODY' if i in [346863,347363,347549] else ('COMPLETE_SOURCE_INTERNAL_CONTRARY_BRIDGE' if i==347506 else 'BOUNDED_UNCLEARED'),'novelty':'FAIL_KNOWN_PUBLIC_OR_CORRECTION' if i in [346863,347363,347506,347549] else 'NOT_ESTABLISHED','significance':'FAIL_FOR_NEW_CAMPAIGN_CREDIT' if i in [346863,347363,347506,347549] else 'UNQUALIFIED','formal':'NOT_RUN_NOT_AUTHORIZED','independent':'NOT_PERFORMED','acceptance':'NONE_ROOT_ONLY'},'source_text':('texts/'+src+'.txt') if src else None}
assert len(results)==20 and set(map(int,results))==set(json.loads(Path('reservation.json').read_text())['ids'])
for n,data in [('results.json',results),('provenance.json',list(pmap.values())),('terminal-exclusions.json',{'346863':'KNOWN_PUBLIC_EXACT_QUOTIENT_BOUND','347363':'KNOWN_PUBLIC_EXACT_CONJECTURE_REFUTATION','347549':'KNOWN_PUBLIC_EXACT_ALL_N_ACTION_HOMOMESY','347506':'ROUTINE_SOURCE_INTERNAL_PARAMETER_CORRECTION','no_other_terminal_exclusions':True,'all_other_ids':'parked or held, not ruled routine'})]:
 subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B','write_lane.py',n],input=json.dumps(data,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False),text=True,check=True)
print('exact20; four terminal zero-credit screening outcomes; sixteen unresolved holds/parks')
